name: rivet
description: Configures C/C++ IntelliSense from your rivet build, so project and dependency headers resolve with no squiggles.

rivet.binaryPath.description: rivet binary (PATH name or absolute path) used to generate compile_commands.json.

rivet.profile.description: Build profile whose flags feed IntelliSense.

rivet.autoConfigure.description: Point .vscode/c_cpp_properties.json at the compile database when missing (runs `rivet compile-commands` only if the database itself is missing).
